scope: Evaluate and serve ISTA-DASLab's disaggregated NVFP4 Qwen3.8-27B prefiller on one B550 RTX 3090 Ti, then qualify it as a keyed CCR fallback route.
source_dirty_scope: This receipt and its architecture work-log entry only.

paper.title: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode

runtime.ampere_semantics: NVFP4 tensors are executable on SM86 through the fork's generic dequantize/Q8_1/DP4A MMQ path. This is W4A8-style execution, not native Blackwell FP4xFP4 W4A4 MMA; no Blackwell speedup is inherited.

artifact_verification.mac_download: hfd full verification: 64 IQ2_S blocks at revision b42f9b32 and one decoder at revision 4ca72078
artifact_verification.block_structural_probe: llama-gguf on block 1 found odp.layer/kind, odp.scale and odp.act_scale KV entries; q/z/out/gate/up/down are GGML type nvfp4 and ba.weight is BF16.

paired_generation.hardware: GPU0 only: one NVIDIA RTX 3090 Ti; GPU1 held only the process's 272 MiB CUDA context
paired_generation.common: IQ2_S decoder, temperature 0, seed 42, reasoning off, 160-token cap, one short turn

long_paper_passage.prompt: First 24,000 whitespace-normalized characters of the fetched arXiv text plus the same one-sentence question; llama-server reported 3,424 prompt tokens.

authentication.credential: CCR_QWEN27B_NVFP4_B550_API_KEY in the private Mac runtime credential store; value never logged

hardening: localhost-only bind behind the authenticated SSH tunnel
prompt cache, context checkpoints, cache RAM, and idle-slot caching disabled to avoid repeated ODP block streams
service.configuration: Qwen3.8-27B IQ2_S decoder, 64 local IQ2_S ODP blocks, GPU0, 16384 context, 8192 batch and micro-batch
service.startup_shutdown_recovery: A clean stop released GPU0 from 11368 MiB to 1 MiB and closed port 18098; start returned active service, authenticated /v1/models HTTP 200, MainPID 646284, Result=success, NRestarts=0.

ccr_activation.api_base: http://127.0.0.1:18082/v1 through the existing ZeroTier-first B550 SSH tunnel
ccr_activation.staged_validation: 44/44 policy tests passed; staged post-sync check had zero drift; new provider preflight HTTP 200
ccr_activation.live_validation: All four consumer configs synced, post-sync check had zero drift, and all four listeners restarted idle-gated with new PIDs and healthy checks.

routed_request.backend_proof: Before the clean service restart, B550 lifetime counters equaled the sum of direct short, direct long, and routed requests: 3494 prompt tokens and 77 predicted tokens, with zero processing or deferred requests.

preflight_preexisting_failures: deepseek returned 402 on its messages probe

checks.name: authenticated-service-smoke
checks.command: unauthenticated /v1/models, authenticated /v1/models, /health, short chat, and 3424-token paper-passage chat

non_claims: No task accuracy, perplexity, logit KL, or BF16 oracle measurement was run for the Qwen3.8-27B artifact; paper benchmark numbers were not reproduced.
SM86 execution is not native NVFP4 W4A4 and must not be compared with the paper's Blackwell GB10 speedups.
The long-prompt ODP number comes from llama-server while its decoder-only control comes from llama-cli; both use the same model, prompt, seed, GPU, and token budget, but not the same process harness.
Both long arms ran with a warm file cache; this is not a cold-NVMe TTFT benchmark.
No concurrent request, varied-prompt interleave, multi-turn cache behavior, power, or availability soak was measured.

The model's literal sentence denied serving disaggregated prefill even though it returned the requested marker; routing is proven by model ID and exact backend token-counter deltas, not by that assertion.

The B550 service intentionally did not enable unsupported user-systemd namespace/capability sandbox directives after they failed at CAPABILITIES before exec; authentication, localhost binding, private key mode, disabled UI, and systemd supervision remain enforced.
No public Hugging Face upload or upstream contribution occurred.
